name: Advanced AI Trading Bot v2 - Clean

parameters.content:
## Environment Variables Required

Set these in n8n Settings > Environment or Docker compose:

- `BINANCE_API_KEY` — Futures API key (no withdrawal permission)
- `BINANCE_API_SECRET` — Futures API secret
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` — Claude API key (optional; bot degrades gracefully without it)
- `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` — Your Telegram group/channel ID

## Telegram Credential
Update the credential ID in each Telegram node to match your n8n Telegram credential.

## Binance Hedge Mode
Ensure your Futures account has Hedge Mode disabled (one-way position mode).
